entities.name: Amédée Grab

entities.summary: Amédée Grab, O.S.B. was a Swiss prelate of the Catholic Church who served as bishop of Chur from 1998 to 2007. He was an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Lausanne from 1987 to 1995 and then bishop there until 1998.
